required_changes: Create workspace.hpp with exactly six WorkspaceId values in Dashboard, Control, Inspect, Runtime, Performance, Scenarios order and stable labels.
Create panel.hpp with the approved PanelSlot values, valid workspace/slot mapping helpers, DebugPanelContext and PanelContribution contract.
Create panel_registry.hpp/panel_registry.cpp implementing explicit bounded-by-registration PanelRegistry storage, validation, deterministic ordering and per-workspace span retrieval.

Create ui_session_state.hpp with selected workspace defaulting to Dashboard, activity auto-scroll preference, and a frame-local control-submission marker used only to preserve same-dispatch presentation refresh.

Create workbench.hpp/workbench.cpp. DebugWorkbench owns one non-docking header/sidebar/content/footer shell, renders exactly six workspace navigation items, renders registered contributions for the selected workspace, shows an explicit empty state for workspaces with no contributions, and shows the latest bounded Activity entry in the footer.

Refactor the existing buildImGuiPanels compatibility entrypoint to render the new Workbench shell. It may rebuild the small explicit registry per frame and persist the selected workspace through the active ImGui context storage; it must not use a process-global/static registry/session singleton. Keep the function source-compatible for current Windows/Web callers until PX0-06.

Move the current legacy panel body under the transitional contribution, remove its top-level ImGui window ownership, preserve Selection, Undo/Redo, Brush/Eraser, Pan, Surface and current diagnostic readouts, and mark frame-local control submission after router intents so existing same-dispatch redraw behavior remains.
Move ImGuiSkiaRenderer declaration/implementation unchanged into imgui_skia_renderer.hpp/imgui_skia_renderer.cpp. Preserve A8 atlas/normalized UV/white paint/kModulate behavior.

Replace controller.hpp/controller.cpp with the approved DebugControllerContext/DebugController orchestration boundary. DebugController owns DebugSnapshotAssembler, DebugActivityLog, DebugControlRouter, PanelRegistry, DebugUiSessionState, DebugWorkbench and latest DebugSnapshot. buildImGuiFrame follows the frozen single-capture order and returns whether panel intents requested a presentation refresh.

Delete panels.hpp and remove DebugPanel/PanelState/DebugController::panels taxonomy. Reconcile panel_model.hpp/panel_model.cpp so DebugPanelModel cannot remain a parallel taxonomy: remove describe()/old enum mapping; retain only canSubmitProductControl temporarily if the DUI-M1 regression target needs it.
Add panel_registry_test.cpp and workbench_state_test.cpp and wire PX0PanelRegistry/PX0Workbench CTest targets.
Update debug_ui_test.cpp, dui_m1_panel_model_test.cpp and CMake only as mechanically required by the intentional taxonomy/renderer/controller change.

Update windows_imgui_skia_debug_ui_contract_test.py so renderer-path assertions point to imgui_skia_renderer files and shell structural assertions prove common Workbench ownership. Do not change Windows/Web production hosts in PX0-04.
